description: Create a coworking space comparison spreadsheet at /home/ga/Documents/Spreadsheets/coworking_comparison.xlsx. Enter 5 coworking spaces with different pricing models (day pass, punch card, monthly flex). Calculate cost per visit for each space, then calculate total monthly costs at 8 visits and 10 visits per month. Use formulas for calculations. For monthly flex plans, calculate overage charges when usage exceeds included days. Save the spreadsheet (Ctrl+S).
